req.title: Content-Type is JSON
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /players endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-026 mandates that every /players/* endpoint returning a body must set Content-Type: application/json. We must verify: (1) all body-returning endpoints (GET /players/, GET /players/{id}, GET /players/squadnumber/{n}, POST /players/) return exactly 'application/json' in Content-Type; (2) no-body endpoints (PUT 204, DELETE 204) are excluded from the requirement; (3) error responses (4xx) that carry a JSON body also set the correct Content-Type. Tests use exact string matching to catch mutations that change the header value, and cover positive (2xx), negative (4xx), and boundary (single-item collection vs empty) cases.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
GET /players/ returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array body
trace: R-PLAYER-026: GET /players/ returns body -> Content-Type must be application/json
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26

tests.name: test_post_player_content_type_is_application_json
preconditions: No player with squad_number=99 exists in the database

actions: Send POST /players/ with a valid PlayerRequestModel payload for squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains the created player with squadNumber=99
trace: R-PLAYER-026: POST /players/ returns body -> Content-Type must be application/json

tests.name: test_put_no_content_204_has_no_body_content_type_not_required

PUT /players/squadnumber/1 with valid matching body returns HTTP 204 No Content
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/1 with valid body matching squad_number=1
Verify 204 response has no body (requirement R-PLAYER-026 excludes no-body responses)
expected: R-PLAYER-026 does not apply to 204 No Content responses

tests.name: test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_application_json_content_type
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
All GET endpoints and POST endpoint return bodies
actions: Assert each response has Content-Type starting with application/json
expected: All three Content-Type headers start with 'application/json'
trace: R-PLAYER-026: all /players/* endpoints returning a body must use application/json
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_application_json_content_type():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/players/'),
        ('GET', '/players/squadnumber/10'),
        ('GET', '/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c'),
    ]
    for method, url in endpoints:
        r = client.request(method, url)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {url} returned {r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), (
            f'{method} {url} Content-Type was {ct!r}, expected application/json'
        )
        body = r.json()
        assert body is not None
